column1: # target: national Pokédex species (1..1025, generations 1-9), species-level fields

# source: EXTERNAL/PROBABLE, not from the game files: PokeAPI data/v2/csv (commit 5ee47a9a9c1229632ec4b473a9c1c53026e005dd, fetched 2026-10-17; BSD-3-Clause) + Pokemon Showdown (MIT, commit 7244fe8e28fa8bc4d0809ae30d183c608b62bb2b) for the Legends: Z-A learnsets. For species/forms with active rows in data/pml_personal.tsv the VERIFIED game sheets always win at load time (crates/pla/src/national.rs).

# semantics: one row per species; gender_rate is PokeAPI's female eighths (-1 = genderless); gender_raw is the engine-style byte DERIVED from it (255 genderless, 0 all male, 254 all female, else f*254/8); growth_group is the PLA exp group id of data/pml_grow_table.tsv DERIVED from PokeAPI's growth curve; entry_count is the number of national form entries of the species; base_experience is the default form's PokeAPI value.
